name: jwt-lab
description: A self-contained teaching lab: build a JWT auth system, attack a deliberately vulnerable version, then secure it against those same attacks.

scripts.attack:all: for f in attacks/0*.js; do echo "\n===== $f ====="; node "$f"; done
scripts.genkeys: openssl genpkey -algorithm RSA -out keys/private.pem -pkeyopt rsa_keygen_bits:2048 && openssl rsa -in keys/private.pem -pubout -out keys/public.pem

author: 02230289.cst@rub.edu.bt
